title: Align TeamDelete tool with the TS baseline
objective: Implement all TeamDelete improvements identified by the per-tool subagent report so the Go clone matches the original TypeScript tool in public contract, runtime logic, robustness, state lifecycle, and tests.

context.problem: TeamDelete 的 Go 版已经具备基础入口、当前 team map 清理、持久化 team.json 删除，以及 active non-lead 成员拒绝清理的核心护栏。但对照 TS 基准 ../src/tools/TeamDeleteTool/TeamDeleteTool.ts 和 ../src/utils/swarm/teamHelpers.ts，Go 仍不是完整生命周期等价：TS TeamDelete 是严格空输入、只作用于 appState 中的当前 team，并在清理成功后做 best-effort 的 team 目录、inbox、task 目录、worktree、session-cleanup 注册、颜色、leader task-list 和 AppState inbox/teamContext 清理。Go 当前实现隐藏接受 team_id，no-op 输出包含 null team_name，删除深度基本限于 team.json，未清 task/worktree/session cleanup/coordinator bus/registered agents，并且 active-member 与损坏 config 的鲁棒性和 TS 的 optional isActive 语义不完全一致。

parallelization_notes: Can be assigned to an implementation subagent after listed dependencies are available. Avoid running concurrently with another task that owns the same files.

improvement_points.title: Go 隐藏接受 team_id，偏离 TS 严格空输入和 current-team-only 语义
improvement_points.description: TS TeamDelete 的输入是 z.strictObject({})，并且 call() 只从 appState.teamContext.teamName 读取当前 team。Go Schema 暴露为空对象，但 TeamDeleteInput 仍接受 team_id，Execute 会优先删除该 ID 对应的 manager team；Go 测试也依赖显式 team_id。no-team/no-op 输出也不同：TS data 中 team_name 为 undefined，模型侧 JSON.stringify 会省略该字段；Go 显式返回 team_name:null。

improvement_points.title: Go 只删除 team.json，未递归清理 team 目录和 mailbox/inbox 状态
improvement_points.description: TS cleanupTeamDirectories 对 ~/.claude/teams/{team} 递归 rm -rf，因此 config、inboxes、lock 文件和其他 team-local 状态都会被删除。Go TeamDelete 只调用 swarm.DeleteTeamConfig；该函数删除 team.json 和 team.json.lock，只有目录为空时才删除目录。Go mailbox 文件位于同一 team 目录的成员子目录下，所以只要存在 inbox，TeamDelete 后目录会保留。

improvement_points.title: Go 没有删除 team-scoped task 目录，也没有对 task-list 切换发出等价状态更新
improvement_points.description: TS TeamCreate 为 team 创建/重置 task list，把 leader task-list 解析切到 sanitized team name；TeamDelete cleanupTeamDirectories 删除 ~/.claude/tasks/{team} 并 notifyTasksUpdated，随后 clearLeaderTeamName 再次通知订阅者切回 session 作用域。Go RuntimeScope 可通过 TeamManager.CurrentTeamName 解析当前 task list，但 TeamManager 没有 TaskStore/cleanup callback，TeamDelete 只清 activeTeamID 和 team.json，没有删除 ~/.claude/tasks/{team} 或等价通知。

improvement_points.title: Go team config 不持久化 teammate worktreePath，TeamDelete 也不销毁 team worktrees
improvement_points.description: TS TeamFile member 支持 worktreePath；TeamDelete 清理时先读取所有 member.worktreePath，逐个 git worktree remove --force，失败再 rm -rf，然后才删除 team/task 目录。Go swarm.TeamMember 没有 WorktreePath 字段；Agent spawnTeammate 的响应会返回 worktree_path，但写入 team config 的 TeamMember 不保存该路径，TeamDelete 也没有 worktree cleanup。

improvement_points.title: Go 缺少 session-created team 跟踪、TeamDelete unregister、以及退出时孤儿 team 清理
improvement_points.description: TS TeamCreate 在成功写 team file 后 registerTeamForSessionCleanup；TeamDelete 成功清理后 unregister，避免 gracefulShutdown 重复清理；如果进程退出而 team 未显式删除，cleanupSessionTeams 会杀 orphan pane 并清理所有本 session 创建的 team 目录。Go TeamManager 没有 session-created set 或 cleanup hook；TeamCreate 只保存 config、注册 coordinator agents、写入 manager map；TeamDelete 没有 unregister 等价逻辑。

improvement_points.title: Go TeamDelete 没有拆除 coordinator agents、MessageBus subscriptions 或后台 teammate sessions
improvement_points.description: TS TeamDelete 清空 appState.teamContext 和 inbox，移除 UI/运行时对 teammates 的可见引用；在 TS 设计里清理前 active member 必须已 graceful shutdown。Go TeamCreate 会把 agents 注册到 coordinator，并在 MessageBus 订阅；TeamDelete 只删 TeamManager.teams 和 activeTeamID，不从 coordinator.agents 移除、不 Unsubscribe、不 abort/cleanup BackgroundTaskManager 中的 spawned teammates。Go 还存在 no-team MessageBus fallback，旧订阅者在 team 删除后仍可能被 SendMessage 命中。

improvement_points.title: Go bool isActive 无法表达 TS 的 optional isActive，缺字段成员会被当作 idle
improvement_points.description: TS TeamFile 中 member.isActive 是 optional；TeamDelete 把 isActive !== false 的 non-lead 成员视为 active，因此旧 team file 或未标记 isActive 的成员会阻止清理。Go TeamMember.IsActive 是 bool，JSON 缺字段会反序列化为 false；activeNonLeadTeamMembers 跳过 IsActive == false 的成员，因此缺 isActive 的成员会被当作 idle 并允许清理。

improvement_points.title: Go 对损坏/不可读 team config 和删除错误的处理比 TS 更硬，且状态更新顺序可能留下不一致
improvement_points.description: TS readTeamFile 对 ENOENT 返回 null，对其他读取/解析错误记录 debug 并返回 null；cleanupTeamDirectories 对 rm team/task 目录错误只记录日志，整体路径仍清 AppState。Go activeNonLeadTeamMembers 对非 not-found 的 LoadTeamConfig 错误直接返回工具错误；TeamDelete 先从 manager 删除 team，再调用 DeleteTeamConfig，若磁盘删除失败则返回 IsError，但内存态已经清掉。

improvement_points.title: Go 没有 TeamDelete 的 tengu_team_deleted 生命周期 analytics hook
improvement_points.description: TS TeamDelete 在有 teamName 且清理路径执行后发出 tengu_team_deleted，并携带 team_name。Go 现有 TeamDelete 实现没有等价 analytics hook 或 pluggable event sink；代码库已有 agent/tool analytics hook 模式，但 TeamDelete 没接入。

implementation_subtasks.title: Align TeamDelete input and no-op output with TS current-team contract
acceptance_criteria: TeamDelete Execute with any unexpected input key, including team_id, follows TS strict-object behavior by returning a validation/tool error before cleanup, or the shared validator rejects it consistently with other strict tools.
TeamDelete no-team/no-op response serializes success/message and does not include team_name:null.
Existing tests that pass team_id are rewritten around current-team behavior.
Schema remains an empty object and no Go-only TeamDelete parameter is documented or accepted.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Remove or reject the hidden team_id path for TeamDelete so execution always uses TeamManager.currentTeamID/current team, and adjust no-team JSON output so team_name is omitted instead of encoded as null.

implementation_subtasks.title: Recursively clean team directory and mailbox files on TeamDelete
acceptance_criteria: A team directory containing team.json, team.json.lock, mailbox inbox files, inbox locks, and arbitrary team-local files is gone after successful TeamDelete.
Deleting a missing team directory remains a no-op success.
Cleanup cannot escape the configured teams root even with unusual team names.
Mailbox tests cover that TeamDelete removes mailbox remnants written by SendMessage.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Replace the config-file-only deletion path with a TS-equivalent team directory cleanup helper that removes the whole sanitized team directory, including inbox subdirectories and lock files, while preserving path validation and no-op behavior for missing teams.

implementation_subtasks.title: Delete team-scoped TaskStore directories and refresh task scope on cleanup
acceptance_criteria: When a team is active, TeamDelete removes the task directory for the sanitized team name without deleting explicit CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID or unrelated session task dirs.
After TeamDelete, RuntimeScope.TaskListID falls back to session ID/default because TeamManager.CurrentTeamName is empty.
Task cleanup is best-effort like TS and does not leave TeamManager active solely because the task dir is absent.
Tests create fake team task files and verify they are removed during TeamDelete.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Wire a task-list cleanup callback or TaskStore reference into TeamManager so TeamDelete removes ~/.claude/tasks/{sanitized-team-name}, and add an internal notification/hook surface if needed to mirror TS task-list change notifications after clearing the current team.

implementation_subtasks.title: Persist teammate worktree metadata and destroy team worktrees during TeamDelete
acceptance_criteria: Team members spawned with worktree isolation persist enough metadata for TeamDelete to find their worktree paths.
TeamDelete removes clean team worktrees via git worktree remove --force and falls back to removing missing/non-worktree directories without failing hard.
Changed worktree safety policy is explicitly chosen and documented to match TS, which force-removes team worktrees.
Tests cover existing path, missing path, and git worktree removal behavior.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Extend persisted TeamMember metadata with worktreePath and any repo/branch data needed for safe cleanup, write it when spawning team teammates, and add a TeamDelete cleanup step that mirrors TS destroyWorktree: git worktree remove --force first, then filesystem fallback.

implementation_subtasks.title: Add session-created team cleanup tracking and shutdown cleanup
acceptance_criteria: TeamCreate registers each successfully persisted team for session cleanup only after the config write succeeds.
TeamDelete unregisters cleaned teams so shutdown does not double-clean them.
A TeamManager cleanup method removes all still-registered teams and clears the registry; signal/main shutdown calls it best-effort.
Tests can call the cleanup method directly to prove orphan team dirs are removed and explicitly deleted teams are not reprocessed.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Introduce TeamManager-owned session-created team tracking. TeamCreate should register newly created teams, TeamDelete should unregister after explicit cleanup, and process shutdown/global cancellation should invoke a best-effort cleanupSessionTeams equivalent for teams still registered.

implementation_subtasks.title: Tear down coordinator agents, MessageBus subscriptions, and background teammates
acceptance_criteria: TeamDelete removes all team agent IDs from coordinator.agents and unsubscribes their MessageBus channels.
SendMessage after TeamDelete cannot route to old team members through the no-team MessageBus fallback.
TeamDispatch after TeamDelete fails because the team is gone and cannot execute against stale coordinator agents.
Background teammates associated with the deleted team are aborted or otherwise marked inactive/cleaned according to existing BackgroundTaskManager lifecycle.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Add coordinator unregister/reset primitives and call them from TeamDelete for every agent recorded in TeamInfo and persisted team config; abort or detach corresponding background teammate sessions so deleted teams cannot receive messages or execute dispatch work.

implementation_subtasks.title: Match TS optional isActive semantics in active-member guard
acceptance_criteria: A non-lead member with isActive:true blocks TeamDelete.
A non-lead member with isActive:false does not block TeamDelete.
A non-lead member with no isActive field blocks TeamDelete, matching TS optional-field behavior.
SaveTeamConfig still writes current Go-created members with explicit isActive values.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Represent persisted TeamMember.isActive as tri-state or add custom decode/predicate logic so absent isActive is treated as active unless explicitly false, matching TS m.isActive !== false.

implementation_subtasks.title: Make TeamDelete cleanup best-effort and recoverable like TS
acceptance_criteria: Corrupt team.json does not prevent TeamDelete from clearing current team state and attempting directory cleanup.
Missing team config remains a no-op cleanup path.
If a cleanup sub-step fails, state ordering is deterministic and retry behavior is documented/tested.
Active-member refusal remains strict when the team config is readable and active members are present.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Change TeamDelete cleanup so unreadable/corrupt team config and filesystem cleanup failures are handled in TS style: log/collect cleanup diagnostics, continue clearing current runtime state, and avoid leaving manager state half-cleared in ways that prevent retry.

implementation_subtasks.title: Add TeamDelete lifecycle analytics hook
acceptance_criteria: Successful cleanup of an existing team emits exactly one tengu_team_deleted event with team_name.
No-team no-op and active-member refusal do not emit the delete event.
Tests can install/reset the hook without cross-test leakage.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Add a small pluggable analytics/event hook for TeamDelete and emit tengu_team_deleted with team_name only when a concrete team was cleaned, matching the TS lifecycle event without coupling the tool to a concrete analytics backend.

acceptance_criteria: TeamDelete input validation and schema behavior match the original TS implementation for all report gaps.
TeamDelete model-visible output and structured result data match TS golden fixtures.
TeamDelete runtime side effects, state transitions, permission decisions, and error branches listed in improvement_points are implemented or explicitly documented as intentionally out of scope.
All implementation_subtasks acceptance criteria are satisfied.

risks: Some subtasks touch shared runtime surfaces; coordinate with foundation tasks to avoid incompatible local adapters.
non_goals: Do not make unrelated behavior changes outside this tool unless required by a listed dependency.
notes_for_assignee: Start by adding or updating parity fixtures, then implement the smallest vertical slice that makes a failing fixture pass. Keep TS evidence lines in comments or test names where useful.
